messages:
olivia: Heads-up: customer onboarding hit a weird streaming parity issue across SDKs. Node/Python flush correctly but Go SDK sometimes leaves partial event in buffer when client disconnects, so sampleapp UI shows duplicate final token.

kevin: which version/go runtime? any repro?

olivia: go sdk v0.9.2. Repro: run sampleapp behind a flaky proxy and abort client mid-stream. Node & Python flush buffered lines on EOF; Go waits for blank line. Minimal repro: `curl --limit-rate 10k --output - http://localhost:3000/stream | head -c 200` then kill curl.

marta: that's a parity bug. Parser should treat EOF/connection close as implicit event boundary. Also need idle-flush for mobile networks.

kevin: ok. Also saw chunk reordering on their infra which exposed our assumption that each `data:` block equals an event. Need assembly logic: accumulate lines until blank line, but also tolerate chunks that get split or reordered.

olivia: can we add a small config flag `sse.idle_flush_ms` with a sane default (500ms) so onboarded customers can relax it if they have noisy networks? Document in sampleapp README.

marta: plan: 1) patch Go parser to flush on EOF; 2) add idle-flush timer and make it configurable; 3) add dedupe using `id:` if present else hash of payload for short window; 4) add unit tests for abort/reorder and an integ using mitmproxy.

kevin: will open PR and tag @marta for review. Also add a small `onboarding/troubleshooting.md` snippet explaining proxy keepalive and disconnect symptoms so new users don't assume model stuck.

sdk-ci: CI: branch fix/go-sse-eof created, tests queued.

olivia: thanks — customer unblock is urgent, so please prioritize the patch. Small README note would have saved them an hour.

marta: ack. I'll include a tiny simulate script `scripts/simulate_truncate.sh` in sampleapp so devs can repro locally.

sdk-ci: merged to main after green. Release note: "Go/Node/Python SDKs: improved SSE parity 1 - flush buffered events on EOF, configurable idle flush, and lightweight dedupe to handle truncated/duplicated chunks. Sampleapp updated with repro scripts and troubleshooting."
